thread:
ana: thanks for the all-hands. opening this thread to capture follow-ups from the wins/losses segment  post clarifying Qs for leadership or quick asks and i'll bucket them for triage.

matt: field signal: multiple AEs asking for per-route cost drilldown in the console (not just billing export). is that on the roadmap or a quick shim?

ana: noted. product & billing team talked about an export API + console view. short-term: export beta; longer-term: native console drilldown. i'll confirm dates.

leah: sales win note: a customer signed because our regional failover demo + fallback routing example removed their single-region risk. can we make a short "fallback + failover" playbook with 2 config snippets and a demo script?

sam: yes please. loss pattern: a POC regressed after switching to a quantized variant. customer couldn't reproduce on our hosted model. we need a recommended pinning policy and a regression smoke test.

priya: i can own a minimal eval checklist: golden prompts, token-diff quickcheck, latency smoke, and a short embedding drift probe. will draft by Fri.

derek: partner blocking ask: per-tenant KV cache controls and an eviction API. partner needs a way to pin per-tenant TTLs. who owns prioritization?

jordan: infra needs anonymized billing-event samples to prototype the per-route cost pane. @matt can you drop a sanitized sample?

taylor: quick ops question for leadership: SLA pilot for Dedicated  any firm dates? ops is planning capacity reservations.

ana: Dedicated SLA pilot = targeted next month for a small cohort; ops please treat date as tentative until legal signs off. i'll push an update end of week.

matt: uploading a sanitized billing sample to the infra drive now. link: https://rwd.inc/share/billing-sample (sanitized).

leah: playbook wishlist (my proposal): 1) fallback+failover playbook + demo snippet, 2) quantization/regression checklist, 3) cost-visibility how-to, 4) per-tenant cache controls explainer, 5) SLA onboarding checklist. each should have an "AE escalation ask" snippet.

sam: +1. also add a short mitigation list for quantization regressions (pin variant, roll back kernel, increase precision).

ana: action items: ana to run triage and create engineering tickets for top-5; leah+sam to draft fallback playbook; priya to draft eval checklist; derek to capture partner KV requirements in a ticket; matt to share billing sample (done); taylor/ops to keep pilot capacity tentative.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-2155 "Win/Loss signal triage & playbooks" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya, derek. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-2155 :spiral_calendar:

ops-bot: Note: Dedicated pilot cluster reservation 2028-03-04, watch for legal sign-off slips.

ana: i'll circulate a short doc with the handoff rules (Solutions Eng vs SE vs CS) and the triage outcomes. closing thread in 48h unless there's more. thanks! :handshake:
